purpose_context: Org pack authors run charter org validate or doctrine pack validate before publishing. Today an edge in drg/fragment.yaml that points at a missing asset or directive passes with zero errors, so a broken reference reaches consumers. This mission makes both commands report it, with the same rules the sharded layout already uses.
purpose_tldr: Pack validation fails closed on dangling edges in the canonical drg/fragment.yaml org-pack layout (#5833).
